limits: This is not a zero-advisory dependency graph. Eight records remain, including transitive propagation.
The remaining Zod3 dependency is required by the pinned PayPal Toolkit. Blanket replacement with Zod4 would change the Toolkit contract.

Errand admits only the exact frozen $12 sample arguments before creating a separate worker, with a 20-second timeout and sample-only credentials. Its OpenAI adapter does not import the AI SDK or LangChain adapters.
Application JSON is bounded to 32 KiB before parsing; direct application and Vercel Zod4 copies are patched.
The existing immutable Bramble isolated runner and Python runtime images have not been rebuilt or claimed patched by this web dependency change.
